segments.tha-ap545:5.3: Sutvā jinassa taṃ vākyaṃ, sāvakassa guṇaṃ bahuṃ.
segments.tha-ap545:7.3: Sarena mahatā vīro [sussarena mahāvīro (sī. pī.)], idaṃ vacanamabravi.
segments.tha-ap545:10.1: “‘Khattiyena mahādānaṃ, dinnaṃ sattāhikampi vo [sattahikaṃ mi vo (sī.), sattahikādhikaṃ (syā.), sattahikaṃ vibho (pī.)];
segments.tha-ap545:11.3: Appameyyamhi buddhamhi, sasaṅghamhi patiṭṭhitā [saṃghamhi suppatiṭṭhitā (sī. pī.)].
segments.tha-ap545:12.1: “‘Dakkhiṇā tāya [dakkhiṇādāya (syā. pī.)] ko vattā, appameyyaphalā hi sā;
segments.tha-ap545:12.3: Api ce sa mahābhogo, ṭhānaṃ pattheti uttamaṃ.
segments.tha-ap545:14.3: Gotamo nāma gottena, satthā loke bhavissati.
segments.tha-ap545:15.3: Sīvali nāma nāmena, hessati satthu sāvako’.
segments.tha-ap545:18.3: Dayito passito ceva, āsiṃ kammantavāvaṭo [kammantabyāvaṭo (sī. syā. ka.)].
segments.tha-ap545:20.3: Navaṃ dadhiṃ madhuñceva, vicinaṃ neva addasuṃ.
segments.tha-ap545:21.1: “Tadāhaṃ taṃ gahetvāna, navaṃ dadhiṃ madhumpi ca;
segments.tha-ap545:27.3: Tato tassa vipākena, pāpatiṃ [pāpiṭṭhaṃ (syā.) pāpattaṃ (ka.)] nirayaṃ bhusaṃ.
segments.tha-ap545:28.1: “Pacchime ca bhave dāni, jātohaṃ koliye pure;
segments.tha-ap545:28.3: Suppavāsā ca me mātā, mahāli licchavī pitā.
segments.tha-ap545:30.3: Mātā me chandadānena, evaṃ āsi sudukkhitā.
segments.tha-ap545:33.3: Devā nāgā manussā ca, paccaye upanenti me.
segments.tha-ap545:35.3: Lābhaṃ labhāmi sabbattha, vane gāme jale thale.
segments.tha-ap545:38.3: Tato jetavanaṃ gantvā, etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ.
segments.tha-ap545:41.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap545:43.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā sīvalithero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: Athāyasmā sīvalitthero arahattaṃ patvā pattaetadaggaṭṭhāno attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento padumuttaro nāma jinotiādimāha.
Sīlaṃ tassa asaṅkheyyanti tassa padumuttarassa bhagavato sīlaṃ asaṅkheyyaṃ.
Peyyālamukhena niddiṭṭhā, sikkhāvinayasaṃvare”ti.(visuddhi.1.20; paṭi. ma. aṭṭha.1.1.37)–
Bhagavato pana sīlaṃ asaṅkheyyameva saṃkhātuṃ gaṇetuṃ asakkuṇeyyanti attho.

Samādhivajirūpamo yathā vajiraṃ indanīlamaṇiveḷuriyamaṇiphalikamasāragallādīni ratanāni vijjhati chiddāvachiddaṃ karoti, evameva padumuttarassa bhagavato lokuttaramaggasamādhi paṭipakkhapaccanīkadhamme vijjhati bhindati samucchindatīti attho.

Asaṅkheyyaṃ ñāṇavaraṃ tassa buddhassa cattāri saccāni sattatiṃsabodhipakkhiyadhamme saṅkhatāsaṅkhatadhamme ca jānituṃ paṭivijjhituṃ samatthaṃ sayambhūñāṇasabbaññutaññāṇādiñāṇasamūhaṃ asaṅkheyyaṃ, atītānāgatapaccuppannādibhedena saṃkhāvirahitanti attho.
Vimutti ca anopamāti saṃkilesehi vimuttattā sotāpattiphalādikā catasso vimuttiyo anupamā upamārahitā “imā viya bhūtā”ti upametuṃ na sakkāti attho.
